name: lightbox
title: Lightbox
description: A full-screen viewer for a set of pictures (or any media the project renders): swipe or arrow between slides, zoom and pan, a counter, captions, thumbnails, and the picture growing out of the thumbnail that opened it.

meta.when: Looking closely at pictures that are shown small on the page: a listing's photos, a portfolio, attachments. It is a modal dialog, so focus is held inside and returns to the thumbnail of the picture shown when it closes. For a grid of thumbnails that opens it use gallery (GalleryLightbox does both). For one picture with text beside it use dialog; for a row of cards that scroll in the page use a scroll-snap row, not a lightbox. Always give it a LightboxTitle (className="sr-only" hides it) and say how many slides there are with `count`.
